name: AR Internet
summary: Sydney dialup then ADSL ISP since Jan 1994; operated to ~2018 (THE TRUSTEE FOR C.I.A. UNIT TRUST (trust), ABN 72 924 334 435).

events.details: Dialup (SLIP/PPP, shell) then nationwide ADSL + hosting; 'providing online services since January 1994 ... one of Sydney's longest running ISPs' per its own 1997 site.
source: A.R. Internet (Wayback 9 Feb 1997): 'Sydney, Australia. A.R. providing online services since January 1994. One of Sydney's longest running ISPs'
